scripts.services:up: docker compose -p taco_ide -f ./docker/compose.yaml up -d && docker compose -p taco_ide_langfuse -f ./docker/compose.langfuse.yaml up -d
scripts.services:stop: docker compose -p taco_ide -f ./docker/compose.yaml stop && docker compose -p taco_ide_langfuse -f ./docker/compose.langfuse.yaml stop
scripts.services:down: docker compose -p taco_ide -f ./docker/compose.yaml down -v && docker compose -p taco_ide_langfuse -f ./docker/compose.langfuse.yaml down -v
scripts.db:migrate: dotenv -e ../../.env -- npx drizzle-kit migrate --config ./drizzle.config.ts && npm run build
scripts.db:reset: dotenv -e ../../.env -- npx tsx src/db/reset-db.ts && dotenv -e ../../.env -- npx drizzle-kit migrate --config ./drizzle.config.ts && npm run db:seed:dev
scripts.db:reset:push: dotenv -e ../../.env -- npx tsx src/db/reset-db.ts && dotenv -e ../../.env -- npx drizzle-kit push --config ./drizzle.config.ts --force && npm run db:seed:dev
